biography: In 2007 I undertook an honours degree in Property Studies.  This degree challenged me across a wide spectrum of areas including Valuations, Landlord & Tenant, Measurement, Building Technology, development, Property Law, presentations, negotiations and report writing. I am proficient in IT skills having completed the ECDL advanced. In the final year of the degree with additional hard work I managed to achieve top of the class and was awarded student of the year. This encouraged me to undertake a Masters in International Finance. The programme provided a special emphasis on current issues in international economic policy and on recent developments in the areas of multinational investment flows, dynamics of exchange rates, risk management and asset pricing.
